title: Guard claim reaping with device-in-use check
description: collect_stale_session_ids() reaps a claim purely on is_pid_alive(claimant_pid). claimant_pid() binds the claim to os.getppid() — the shell that ran 'simemu claim'. When that shell is short-lived (zsh -c wrapper), the claim reads dead while the DEVICE is still in active use by a different process (xcodebuild -destination id=<udid>). _reap_dead_claims_locked then marks the session expired, freeing the device for a sibling to claim — producing the double-claim incident exclusive.py exists to prevent. Observed live: session s-32cc55 held chard (16D8CDC7) with dead claimant pid 62666 while xcodebuild ran a Vivii test against that same UDID.
acceptanceCriteria: A claim whose claimant PID is dead is NOT reaped while any live process references its device UDID
A claim whose claimant PID is dead AND whose device has no live referencing process IS reaped as before
Device-in-use detection is a pure, injectable function so tests need no real simulator
Existing tests in tests/test_exclusive_claim.py and tests/test_claim_policy.py still pass
proofRequirements: pytest output showing new device-in-use guard tests passing plus the full suite green
